instruction_summary: Extend the prior 2023-2025 living-update ladder to the newest 2026 base models (primarily Qwen3.5-9B-Base, plus gemma-4-12B), reusing all prior per-model results, and re-aggregate + extend the over-time figure to 2026 to report whether the Linear Representation Hypothesis (causal-inner-product orthogonality, linear subspace structure) and the family-not-scale pattern still hold.

steps.description: Read study 001's report/summary/scripts + replication artifacts; copied 001's workspace scripts, codebase (data), and ALL its results/ (5 prior models' metrics + concept_*.pt + intervention_C8.json) into this study's results/ (treat 2023-2025 models as DONE, reuse verbatim)

Verified venv (torch 2.13.0, transformers 5.16.1, CUDA H200) and that Qwen3.5-9B-Base (tie=False), gemma-4-12B (tie=True, ~23GB, fully downloaded) are cached; confirmed arches Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration / Gemma4UnifiedForConditionalGeneration

Smoke test on Qwen3.5-9B-Base BEFORE full run: AutoModelForImageTextToText load OK; unembedding (248320,4096) untied; forward pass -> 33 hidden states (32 layers) + logits; residual-stream forward-hook on dec.layers[16] reads (1,3,4096). Recipe correction: decoder is at m.model.language_model, not m.language_model
Computed LRH core metrics for the 2 new 2026 models via AutoModelForImageTextToText + get_output_embeddings (unembedding), same math as 001 (fp32 eigh, tokenizer-agnostic single-token filter)
steps.command: python run_model_2026.py qwen3.5-9b-base; python run_model_2026.py gemma-4-12b

steps.description: Re-aggregated ALL 7 models (5 reused + 2 new); intersection stays 22 concepts (Llama-2 bound); reproduced prior 5 models' numbers exactly; extended over-time figure to 2026
Built family-not-scale figure (all-27 ratio vs release year, colored by family)
Optional C8 intervention on the 2 new models (merged into intervention_C8.json alongside the prior 5): 'Long live the' + alpha*(male=>female) still flips king->queen and pushes king out of top-5

key_results.verdict: The Linear Representation Hypothesis SURVIVES to the 2026 models: on Qwen3.5-9B-Base and gemma-4-12B the causal inner product is more orthogonal than Euclidean (ratio>1, causal off-diag ~0.063-0.069), all viable single-token concepts are linearly separable (26/26 own, 22/22 intersection), C11 and C8 hold. The 'family-not-scale' pattern holds: the 2026 Qwen3.5 point (1.27) lands inside the Qwen band despite being newer and larger.

comparison_to_original.note: 2026 models stay approximately orthogonal under the causal metric; Llama-2 recomputed in 001 reproduced the on-disk 0.046 exactly.
Always above the causal value on the 2026 models.

comparison_to_original.source_file: derived from concept_g.pt / concept_gamma.pt (2023 anchor); this session for 2026
comparison_to_original.note: Survives (>1) on both 2026 models; below the paper's 1.5-2.5x band, consistent with the family pattern (Qwen ~1.25-1.31, LLaMA ~1.5).

comparison_to_original.quantity: family-not-scale: 2026 Qwen point vs Qwen band
comparison_to_original.note: Advantage tracks family, not year/scale: Qwen stays ~1.25-1.31 across 2024->2026 and 7.6B->9B.
Both 2026 models separate all viable concepts including thing=>part; subspace claim survives.

comparison_to_original.followup: separable |r|<=0.02 vs non-separable r~0.39-0.42 on both 2026 models
comparison_to_original.note: Sanity check holds identically on the 2026 models.

comparison_to_original.original: flips top-1 by alpha=0.2, king out of top-5 by alpha=0.3
comparison_to_original.followup: both 2026 models flip king->queen (top-1 Queen by alpha=0.1) and push king out of top-5 by alpha=0.3
comparison_to_original.note: Causal male=>female steering still works on the 2026 models.

deviations: 2026 loading recipe attribute correction: the text decoder is at m.model.language_model, not m.language_model, for both Qwen3_5ForConditionalGeneration and Gemma4UnifiedForConditionalGeneration. Affects only the optional C8 forward/hook path; the LRH core uses m.get_output_embeddings() and was unaffected. Both 2026 models loaded, forwarded, and hooked successfully (no model descoped).
gemma-4-12B added as the second 2026 point (fully downloaded ~23GB and hookable); base model used per the paper's convention; its embeddings are tied (LRH uses the unembedding = the tied weight).

The paper's '1.5-2.5x' orthogonality-advantage band is not met by the 2026 models (Qwen3.5 1.27, gemma-4 1.38, all-27); the causal metric still improves orthogonality (ratio>1) but by a smaller margin - consistent with the family-not-scale pattern.

22-concept apples-to-apples intersection unchanged from study 001 (Llama-2's tokenizer, not the 2026 models, is the binding constraint; both 2026 models are individually 26/27-viable, dropping only pronoun=>possessive which is already outside the intersection).

Prior five 2023-2025 models were reused verbatim from study 001's on-disk results (not recomputed); re-aggregating them reproduced 001's table exactly. Optional C6 measurement probe not run (as in 001).
